## Seat paused for 12 hours by the maintainer · 2026-11-18T03:29Z

The hourly patrol (`trig_01VGfkscjtswUwd7ZprA2SdZ`) is disabled for the pause. A one-shot resume (`trig_013GoUdfT4vjFsYb5MzKVaBr`) fires at 15:30Z.
